data.title: Add canonical net-policy TLS mode contract
data.description: Review the additive sigil:host/net-policy@1.0.0 interface, generated-binding contract assertion, documentation, canonical digests, and retained Seal initialization. Existing sigil:host/net@1.0.0 must remain unchanged; the new read-only query must reveal only the frozen TLS mode for a granted logical endpoint and no concrete route or authority.

data.reason: LGTM: standalone SDK security review found no reportable issues. The existing net interface is byte-identical across the range; net-policy is read-only, reuses net.error, returns only disabled/direct/upgrade, and grants no stream or route authority. Digests, WIT parsing, generated bindings, native tests/clippy, and wasm32-unknown-unknown check pass. Cross-repo drift remains the expected parallel Sigil integration dependency.

LGTM re-review at a54427b: the only new commit limits push-triggered CI to main while leaving pull_request checks enabled. actionlint, diff checks, and the complete SDK just check gate pass. Live Actions evidence shows a pull_request run for a54427b and no duplicate push run; the prior a3f6e1e head had both pull_request and push events. The previously reviewed contract range remains unchanged and clean.
